purpose: Machine-readable form of the surface-ownership audit. Before this file the A/B/C classification lived only in a handoff document, so nothing compared it against the code — which is how SourceDisclosure drew its own perimeter from the initial public release until rc.59 while being classified as borderless content.

strategies.borderless: Draws no perimeter of its own; the embedding container owns the surface. Enforced: the root element must not declare a border or a border radius.
strategies.embedded-variant: Draws its own perimeter by default and drops it under variant="embedded" to bond with a parent surface. Not auto-verified — the perimeter often sits on an inner message/table surface rather than the root, and the variant wiring differs per component.
strategies.outermost: Contractually the outermost surface; nesting is discouraged. Not auto-verified — these legitimately draw a perimeter, and where they draw it varies.

components.name: StepList
components.note: Each step item is its own bordered card; that is item styling, not a component perimeter.

components.name: AnnotatedImage
components.note: The inner image viewport draws a frame around the picture; the component root does not.

deferredNote: The 2026-07-17 audit left these four drawing their own perimeter with no nested usage in the repository. Give each an embedded variant only when a real nested composition appears; adding it speculatively dilutes the convention.
